note: Fuzzer entry point receives the raw input bytes from the harness; the c-string input with embedded null bytes is passed to the markdown parser.
The callback invokes the markdown parser with the input buffer and its size; the parser treats the buffer as a c-string.
The input size is passed to the parser; the parser's internal buffer handling may not account for embedded null bytes when computing lengths.

The input is processed as a c-string; embedded null bytes terminate the string early in some operations, causing a mismatch between the declared size and the actual processed length, leading to a buffer overflow.
invariant: decoded length must not exceed destination capacity
